findings.title: Change callback reads mutable customizeTarget
findings.message: The gallery overwrites m.customizer.Value from m.layouts[m.customizeTarget] in view(). If the sheet is open and a different Customize button is activated, the target changes while the existing epoch persists only if identity is unchanged; the identity check does revoke it. However, a rejected or stale Change after the target changes could write to the wrong toolbar's layout, since Change reads m.customizeTarget at call time rather than capture time.
findings.suggestion: Capture the target at View time, or disable other Customize buttons while the sheet is open.
findings.evidence: m.customizer = ui.ToolbarCustomizer{ID: "toolbar-customizer", Dismiss: func() { m.customizer.Open = false }, Change: func(value ui.ToolbarLayout) { m.layouts[m.customizeTarget] = value; m.customizer.Value = value }}
